_: THE LIGHTING REGISTRY. Three named directions, orthogonal to the three material treatments in materials.json (?variants=1&treatment=estate&light=raking). Every sun is a real solar position for Fawley Court - 51.55 N, -0.90 E, British National Grid SU 76520 84214 - computed with the NOAA solar position algorithm. Values are named and scaled for out/viewer.html as it stands; tools/LIGHTING.md lists the handful of things the viewer must gain before all of them can be applied.

_units.colour: linear RGB 0-1, the same convention as materials.json. colour_hex beside it is the sRGB hex to hand to THREE.Color.set(), which is what the viewer already does.
_units.sun.direction: unit vector in THREE.JS scene coordinates (+x east, +y up, -z north), pointing FROM the scene TOWARD the sun. sun.position = direction * distance.
_units.sun.skyAzimuthParam: the second argument to the viewer's own setSun(elevDeg, azimDeg). It is NOT a compass bearing: setFromSphericalCoords makes it 180 - true azimuth. See tools/LIGHTING.md.
_units.azimuth_deg: true solar azimuth, degrees clockwise from grid north.
_units.elevation_deg: true solar elevation above the horizon, refraction-corrected.
_units.fog: THREE.Fog, linear: factor = clamp((depth - near)/(far - near), 0, 1). Metres.
_units.shadow.bias: three.js units - a fraction of the shadow camera's near-to-far depth range. _bias_metres beside it is what that works out to in world units.
_units.intensity: three.js light intensity, unitless, as the viewer already uses it.

_model_extents._source: measured in Blender from out/fawley-estate.blend with the overlay and off-estate objects hidden, which is the viewer's default beauty layer set

overcast._intent: Soft high cloud at equinox noon: an even, cool, top-lit condition that shows the plan and the layout of the estate and gives nothing a flattering angle.

_sun._source: NOAA solar position algorithm (the NOAA Solar Calculator formulation) at 51.55 N, -0.90 E. Solar declination +0.352 deg, equation of time -7.14 min. British Summer Time ran 29 Mar to 25 Oct 2026, so the local clock is UTC+0. Verified in Blender by reading the sun lamp's actual beam vector back off the evaluated depsgraph.

fill._: the viewer's HemisphereLight - sky colour above, ground bounce below

ambient._: there is no AmbientLight in the viewer and none should be added - flat ambient is what makes the current render chalky. The ambient term is the PMREM of the Sky dome, scaled by scene.environmentIntensity and then by each material's envMapIntensity.

shadow._fit: fitted to a 855 m plan radius about the model's own centre at a 38.8 deg sun; left/right spans the plan, top/bottom spans the plan foreshortened by sin(elevation) plus the 66 m model height.

ao._: GTAOPass. intensity is gtaoPass.blendIntensity; the rest go through gtaoPass.updateGtaoMaterial({...}). radius is in WORLD METRES.
